description: This file defines the class Minify_CSS_UriRewriter, which rewrites file-relative URIs as root-relative in CSS files, including methods for processing CSS content and handling URI transformations.

classes.name: Minify_CSS_UriRewriter
classes.description: A class that rewrites file-relative URIs to root-relative in CSS files, handling URL and @import statements.

methods.name: rewrite
methods.description: Rewrites CSS content by converting relative URIs to root-relative URIs based on current directory and document root.

methods.name: _uriCB
methods.description: Callback function that processes individual URI matches, converting relative URIs to root-relative paths.
